source_text: It influenced framing within human rights petitions, contributing to submissions at symposia and publications critiquing routine neonatal circumcision, though mainstream medical bodies like the American Academy of Pediatrics continued to cite potential health advantages without adopting the resolution's outright prohibition stance.
